urls.description: How can African commitments on agricultural adaptation become financed interventions and documented results? The AAA Initiative Foundation presents its 10-year assessment of 53 nationally determined contributions, 28 national adaptation plans and 24 Biennial Transparency Reports. It documents where the chain from commitment to plan, finance and reporting breaks, and proposes 5 directions to 2036. The discussion is planned with CGIAR, FAO, the IPCC, the World Bank, the Green Climate Fund, the African Group of Negotiators and civil society. EVENT OBJECTIVES Context. The report assesses the chain linking nationally determined contributions (NDCs), national adaptation plans (NAPs) and Biennial Transparency Reports (BTRs) in Africa. The NDCs declare about USD 566 billion of adaptation needs over their own implementation periods, of which around USD 80 billion is attributed to agriculture in the report's consolidated analysis.
